methodology.windowPresentation: Process-local NSAutomaticWindowAnimationsEnabled=NO before app initialization; shells shown without waiting for content.
methodology.desktopSession: Both timing and companion memory observations retain their launch-time console lock state; --allow-locked-session explicitly permits locked launches.
methodology.content: Centered "Hello, world!", 32-point text, white background, 1280×720 content window. React web hosts include React/ReactDOM; no chat dependencies.
methodology.startup: LaunchServices launch to first of three consecutive frames with the greeting recognized by native-resolution Vision OCR. Window opening still uses three stable changed frames.
methodology.memory: Separate non-recording launch, wait for timing launch's observed content boundary, then median of 3 physical-footprint samples starting 2500 ms later, 200 ms apart. RSS is diagnostic.
methodology.webkit: New WebKit XPC processes relative to each launch baseline are included. Keep other WebKit activity idle during a run.
methodology.size: Logical production .app bytes, excluding symlinks. System frameworks are not bundled.
methodology.order: Discard warmups, rotate runtime order deterministically each round; incomplete or invalid launches retried at most twice.
methodology.comparison: Compare Hello World startup, settled footprint, and bundle size with product initial-content metrics from the same machine/build conditions. Parsing/jump/switch metrics do not apply to Hello World.
